description:
After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer.
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation.
This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK.
If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated.
If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/claims">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_Examine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Claims officer examines claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_Examine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Examine_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteRecommendation" name="Claims officer writes settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Examine_WriteRecommendation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotOK_RepeatRecommendation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Write_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRecommendation" name="Senior claims officer checks recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Write_CheckRecommendation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ClaimStatus</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimStatus" name="Claim marked OK?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ClaimStatus</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OK_Proceed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOK_RepeatRecommendation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProceedClaimHandling" name="Proceed with claim handling">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OK_Proceed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Proceed_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingContinues" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Proceed_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_Examine" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine_WriteRecommendation" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Write_CheckRecommendation" sourceRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ClaimStatus" sourceRef="Task_CheckRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OK_Proceed" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Task_ProceedClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOK_RepeatRecommendation" name="Not OK — return to claims officer" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimStatus" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">claimStatus = 'Not OK'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Proceed_End" sourceRef="Task_ProceedClaimHandling" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingContinues"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
